title: 重生皇叔：制霸三國
logline: 夷陵火起前夕，劉備覺醒重生，這一次他不顧私仇，先取曹魏再吞東吳，逆天改命統一天下！
style_prompt: 3D cartoon style, stylized 3D render, Unreal Engine 5, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, expressive facial features, epic historical atmosphere, sharp edges, smooth textures, highly detailed character models
negative_prompt: realistic, photograph, 2d, sketch, grainy, low resolution, blurry, deformed limbs, messy lines, dull colors

characters.name: 劉備
characters.key_features: middle-aged man, green robe, golden armor, double swords
characters.appearance: Middle-aged man, neat black beard, sharp determined eyes, wearing emerald green imperial silk robes over golden dragon-scale armor, jade crown with green tassels, holding double-edged swords (Shuanggu Jian)
characters.personality: 沉穩冷靜、殺伐果斷、具有超前預判力

characters.name: 諸葛亮
characters.key_features: young man, white robe, feather fan, silver ornament
characters.appearance: Elegant young man, thin face, wearing a white Taoist robe with light blue embroidery, holding a white crane feather fan, silver hair ornament, calm and mysterious expression
characters.personality: 機智過人、忠心耿耿、偶爾對劉備的改變感到震驚

characters.name: 孫權
characters.key_features: young man, purple beard, red royal robe, arrogant
characters.appearance: Young man with a distinct short purple beard, green eyes, wearing extravagant red silk royal robes with gold brocade, jade belt, often showing a sneering or panicked expression
characters.personality: 猜忌心重、色厲內荏、計謀百出但格局有限

characters.name: 曹丕
characters.key_features: young man, dark purple armor, black cape, cold
characters.appearance: Young man, pale skin, sharp hawk-like eyes, wearing dark purple imperial armor with black iron accents, long black flowing cape, majestic silver crown
characters.personality: 陰險狠毒、野心勃勃、極度自負

characters.name: 孫尚香
characters.key_features: young woman, red archery outfit, high ponytail, bow
characters.appearance: Athletic young woman, high ponytail with gold ring, red and white archery outfit, leather arm guards, carrying a decorative recurve bow on her back, heroic and spirited look
characters.personality: 性格火辣、愛恨分明、在親情與大義間掙扎
